top_signals.title: Inside the scramble that moved Thursday's WNBA Finals game to 12:30 p.m. ET
top_signals.summary: Many different options were considered before the WNBA decided to move Thursday's Game 6 of the WNBA Finals to a midday time slot.

top_signals.title: Commission greenlights Czechia's seventh and final payment request for €951 million under NextGenerationEU
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission greenlighted Czechia's seventh payment request worth €951 million under the Recovery and Resilience Facility, the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.
